title: What If Russia Never Sold Alaska?
summary: In 1867 Russia sold Alaska to the United States for just $7.2 million, more land than Texas, California and Montana combined. Why did the Tsar sell? And if he hadn't, would Alaska be Canadian today, or Soviet, with missiles on North American soil? We follow the real story on satellite maps, then tear up the treaty and follow two what-if paths. Everything marked WHAT IF is speculation; everything else is sourced below.
